reasons.correctness: Entity column, DTO field, paged mapping and both controller builders carry displayOrder; toDto gets it through ModelMapper. Hidden tests 4/4. But the seed gives PLN 0 and all unlisted currencies default 0, so PLN is not guaranteed first.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset follows the path, naming, header, rollback and dated changelog.xml comment, and edits no existing changeset. No new *UnitTest class was added; the agent only extended CurrencyServiceUnitTest.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint that reuses the existing mapping paths. The seed data ties PLN with every unseeded currency at 0, which undercuts the stated ordering goal. A reviewer would ask for PLN below the default or for the others to be seeded.
reasons.test_quality: The added asserts only check the Lombok getter, setter and constructor on Currency and CurrencyDtoOut. No test checks that toDto or getDataPagedAndFilteredAsDtos fills displayOrder.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the currency files at the start. After that, navigation for changesets and constructor callers relied on ls, grep and find.
